## Platform Overview

### Mission
Extract brand essence from any website, auto-generate unlimited marketing assets, and automate sales workflows through AI.

### Live Platform
- **App:** https://app.coredna.ai
- **Docs:** https://docs.coredna.ai
- **Status:** https://status.coredna.ai

### Key Capabilities
- 🧬 Brand DNA extraction (AI analysis of brand identity)
- 🎨 Unlimited asset generation (social, email, ads, video, blog)
- 🌐 Instant website creation & deployment
- 🎤 Voice-activated AI assistant (Sonic Co-Pilot)
- 🤖 Workflow automation (n8n-powered)
- 👥 Team collaboration & multi-user workspace
- 📊 Lead hunting & sales automation
- 🔄 Real-time campaign orchestration

---

## Core Architecture

### Technology Stack
```
Frontend:   React 19 + TypeScript + Vite
Backend:    Supabase (PostgreSQL)
AI:         70+ LLM/Image/Video/Voice providers
Automation: n8n workflow engine
Voice:      Web Speech API + custom voice synthesis
Deployment: Vercel / Firebase / Custom servers
Database:   Supabase PostgreSQL
Auth:       Supabase Auth
```

### Project Structure
```
CoreDNA2-work/
├── pages/                    # Main application pages
├── components/               # Reusable React components
├── services/                 # Business logic & API integration
├── contexts/                 # React context providers
├── hooks/                    # Custom React hooks
├── types.ts                  # TypeScript interfaces
├── index.tsx                 # Entry point
└── [config files]            # Vite, Tailwind, TypeScript config
```

---

## Feature Modules

### 1. 🧬 Brand Extraction (ExtractPage)
**What it does:** Analyzes any website and creates a complete brand profile

**Inputs:**
- Website URL
- Optional: Company description, industry context

**Outputs: BrandDNA object containing:**
- Brand name, tagline, mission, elevator pitch
- Core values & key messaging
- Target audience & personas
- SWOT analysis (strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, threats)
- Competitor analysis
- Color palette (primary + secondary) with psychology
- Typography (fonts and usage)
- Visual style (modern, minimalist, corporate, etc.)
- Tone of voice (adjectives, description, personality)
- Sonic identity (voice type, music genre, sound keywords)
- Accessibility guidelines
- Confidence scores (visuals, strategy, tone, overall)
- Trend alignment analysis
- Extended visual identity (logo, patterns, iconography, mood boards)

**Services Used:**
- `enhancedExtractionService.ts` — Main extraction pipeline
- `geminiService.ts` — LLM integration (text generation)
- `advancedScraperService.ts` — Website content scraping
- `healthCheckService.ts` — Validation & error checking

**Key Features:**
- Multi-language support (auto-detects language)
- Recursive analysis (RLM - Recursive Language Models)
- Confidence scoring for quality assurance
- Self-healing mode (validates & regenerates if quality low)

---

### 2. 🎨 Campaign Generation (CampaignsPage)
**What it does:** Generates unlimited marketing assets automatically

**Workflow:**
1. Select brand DNA (from extraction)
2. Define campaign goal (awareness, conversion, engagement, etc.)
3. Choose channels (Instagram, LinkedIn, Twitter, TikTok, Email, Blog)
4. Generate PRD (Product Requirements Document) with user stories
5. Run autonomous mode to generate assets
6. Review, edit, and schedule for posting

**Asset Types Generated:**
- Social media posts (Instagram, LinkedIn, Twitter, TikTok)
- Email campaign content (subject + body)
- Ad copy (headlines + body + CTAs)
- Blog article sections (intro, body, conclusion)
- Video prompts (for video generation)
- Landing page copy

**Asset Components:**
- Headline/title (for SEO, engagement)
- Body copy (channel-optimized length)
- Call-to-action (personalized per channel)
- Image prompt (detailed visual direction)
- Generated image (via image provider)
- Video URL (if video generation enabled)
- Scheduled posting time
- Metadata (channel, type, status)

**Services Used:**
- `campaignPRDService.ts` — PRD generation & story management
- `autonomousCampaignService.ts` — AI-powered story execution
- `campaignSequencingService.ts` — Multi-asset sequencing
- `geminiService.ts` — Asset generation via LLM
- `selfHealingService.ts` — Quality validation & auto-improvement
- `sonicCoPilot.ts` — Voice-based validation

**Key Features:**
- 🚀 **Full Autonomous Mode** — AI executes all stories automatically
- 👣 **Step-by-Step Mode** — Manual approval between stories
- 🔄 **Self-Healing Loop** — Validates assets and regenerates if not meeting criteria
- 📊 **Learning Feedback** — Captures insights from each execution
- 🎨 **Multi-channel Optimization** — Different content per platform
- 🤖 **Recursive Improvement** — Max 10 iterations per story

---

### 3. 🌐 Website Builder (SiteBuilderPage)
**What it does:** Auto-generates and deploys websites based on brand DNA

**Workflow:**
1. Select brand DNA
2. Configure site structure (hero, features, about, CTA, footer)
3. Generate content & visuals
4. Deploy to Vercel, Firebase, or custom domain

**Generated Site Includes:**
- Responsive design (mobile-first)
- Brand colors & typography
- Hero section with brand imagery
- Features/services section
- About/mission section
- Call-to-action sections
- Contact form
- Footer with brand info
- SEO metadata

**Services Used:**
- `siteGeneratorService.ts` — Site structure & content generation
- `siteDeploymentService.ts` — Deployment orchestration
- `vercelService.ts` — Vercel integration
- `firebaseDeploymentService.ts` — Firebase hosting
- `geminiService.ts` — Content generation

**Key Features:**
- 🎨 **Auto-design** from brand DNA
- 🚀 **One-click deployment** to Vercel/Firebase
- 📱 **Mobile-responsive** by default
- 🔍 **SEO-optimized** (metadata, alt text)
- 🔄 **Live editing** before deployment
- 💾 **Version control** (save iterations)

---

### 4. 🎤 Sonic Co-Pilot (SonicLabPage)
**What it does:** Voice-activated AI assistant for real-time brand guidance

**Features:**
- 🎙️ **Voice input** (Web Speech API) — Speak requests naturally
- 🤖 **AI response** — Gemini, OpenAI, etc. understand context
- 🎵 **Voice synthesis** — TTS playback (ElevenLabs, Azure, Google, etc.)
- 🧠 **Brand context aware** — Uses loaded BrandDNA for consistency
- 📞 **Conversational** — Multi-turn dialogue
- 💬 **Chat interface** — Text fallback when voice unavailable

**Services Used:**
- `sonicCoPilot.ts` — Voice conversation pipeline
- `geminiService.ts` — AI understanding & response
- Web Speech API (browser native)
- TTS providers (ElevenLabs, OpenAI, Google, Azure, etc.)

**Supported Commands Examples:**
- "Generate 5 Instagram posts for this brand"
- "What are the brand's core values?"
- "Create email campaign for product launch"
- "Validate if this headline matches the brand tone"
- "Generate website copy for features section"

**Tiers:**
- Free/Pro: Chat only
- Hunter+: Voice input + synthesis

---

### 5. 🚀 Automations (AutomationsPage)
**What it does:** Integrates with n8n for workflow automation

**Automation Types:**
- 📅 **Schedule posts** — Auto-post assets to social media
- 🔄 **Webhook integration** — Connect external services
- 📊 **Lead sync** — Auto-import leads from CRM
- 💌 **Email sequences** — Automated follow-up campaigns
- 📱 **Social sync** — Cross-post to multiple platforms
- 📈 **Analytics sync** — Pull performance data from social providers

**Services Used:**
- `n8nService.ts` — n8n workflow management

- `workflowConfigs.ts` — Pre-built workflow templates

**Supported Platforms:**
- n8n (self-hosted/cloud)

- Make.com
- ActivePieces
- LangChain / LangGraph
- Pipedream
- Relay.app

### 6. 🎯 Battle Mode (BattleModePage)
**What it does:** A/B compare two brands side-by-side

**Features:**
- 📊 **Head-to-head comparison** of two BrandDNA profiles
- 🎨 **Visual analysis** (color palette, imagery style)
- 📝 **Messaging analysis** (tone, values, messaging)
- 💡 **Market positioning** (differentiation, gaps)
- 📈 **Performance metrics** (with scoring)
- 🔍 **Gap analysis** (what's missing vs competitor)
- 📋 **Detailed critique** from brand strategist perspective

**Services Used:**
- `competitorAnalysisService.ts` — Competitive intelligence

---

### 7. 👥 Lead Hunter (LeadHunterPanel component)
**What it does:** AI-powered B2B lead finding & qualification

**Workflow:**
1. Input target industry/location/company size
2. AI scrapes LinkedIn, Google Maps, business directories
3. Qualifies leads based on vulnerability analysis
4. Creates detailed lead profiles with opportunity scoring
5. Generates personalized closer portfolio for each lead

**Lead Profile Includes:**
- Company name, address, website, rating
- Tech stack (detected from website)
- Contact info (email, phone, social profiles)
- **Gap analysis:**
  - Missing website?
  - Low ratings?
  - Weak social presence?
- **Closer portfolio** (personalized sales assets)

**Closer Portfolio Generated:**
- 📧 **Subject line** (attention-grabbing)
- 💬 **Email body** (personalized, benefit-focused)
- 🎯 **Closing script** (objection handling)
- 🛡️ **Objection rebuttals** (pre-written responses)
- 📅 **Follow-up sequence** (5-7 day drip campaign)
- 📱 **Sample posts** (for social outreach)
- 🎨 **Brand essence** (what we discovered about them)

**Services Used:**
- `advancedScraperService.ts` — Web scraping & lead discovery
- `enhancedExtractionService.ts` — Lead brand analysis
- `geminiService.ts` — Content generation (emails, scripts)
- `competitorAnalysisService.ts` — Vulnerability analysis

---

### 8. 📊 Trend Pulse (TrendPulse component)
**What it does:** Identifies trending topics relevant to brand

**Features:**
- 🔥 **Trend detection** — Real-time trending topics
- 📈 **Relevance scoring** — How relevant to your brand
- 💡 **Suggested angles** — Content ideas based on trends
- 🎯 **Topic summaries** — Quick briefing on trending topic
- 🚀 **Campaign ideas** — How to leverage trend for brand

**Services Used:**
- `rocketNewService.ts` — Trend detection & analysis

---

### 9. 🎬 Video Generation (VideoProvidersSection component)
**What it does:** Creates videos from images/prompts

**Engines Supported:**
- **LTX-2** (Lightricks) — Fast, cost-effective (~1 credit)
- **Sora 2 Pro** (OpenAI) — Premium, cinematic (~5 credits)
- **Veo 3** (Google) — Superior physics & coherence (~5 credits)
- Plus: Runway, Kling, Luma, Mochi, HeyGen, Synthesia, etc.

**Tier Limits:**
- **Free:** 5 videos/month (LTX-2 only)
- **Pro:** 50 videos/month (LTX-2 only)
- **Hunter:** Unlimited (LTX-2: 1cr, Sora/Veo: 5cr each)
- **Agency:** Unlimited (all included)

**Services Used:**
- `videoService.ts` — Video generation orchestration
- Individual provider APIs

---

### 10. 📋 Scheduler (SchedulerPage)
**What it does:** Schedule asset posting across channels

**Features:**
- 📅 **Calendar view** — Visual scheduling
- ⏰ **Time zone support** — Post at optimal times
- 🔄 **Bulk scheduling** — Schedule multiple assets at once
- 📊 **Analytics tracking** — Monitor performance post-launch
- 🔗 **Platform sync** — Direct integration with Buffer, Later, etc.

### 11. 🌐 Live Sessions (LiveSessionPage)
**What it does:** Real-time collaboration on brand work

**Features:**

- 💬 **In-app chat** — Discuss changes in real-time
- 📝 **Version history** — Track all changes
- 🔔 **Notifications** — Alerts on team activity

---

### 12. 🤝 Affiliate Hub (AffiliateHubPage)
**What it does:** Partner referral & commission management

**Features:**
- 🔗 **Referral links** — Unique tracking URLs
- 💰 **Commission tracking** — Monitor earnings
- 📊 **Dashboard** — Real-time stats
- 🎁 **Reward tiers** — Increase commission with volume

### 13. 🧪 Brand Simulator (BrandSimulatorPage)
**What it does:** Test brand ideas before execution

**Features:**

- 📝 **Copy testing** — A/B test messaging
- 👥 **Audience testing** — Get feedback from target personas
- 📊 **Predictive scoring** — Estimate performance

---

### 14. 🤖 Agent Forge (AgentForgePage)
**What it does:** Create custom AI agents with guardrails

**Features:**

**Agent Types:**

## Services & Engines

### Core AI Services

#### 1. **Gemini Service** (`geminiService.ts` - 1300+ lines)
Central hub for all AI operations:
- LLM selection & provider routing
- Prompt engineering
- Token counting & optimization
- Response parsing (JSON extraction)
- Image generation
- Campaign asset generation
- Content refinement
- RLM (Recursive Language Models) integration

**Supported LLMs:** 31 providers
- Google Gemini (primary)
- OpenAI GPT-4/4o
- Claude (Anthropic)
- Mistral, DeepSeek, Groq
- Plus 25 others (Qwen, Cohere, etc.)

---

#### 2. **Sonic Co-Pilot Service** (`sonicCoPilot.ts`)
Voice-based AI interaction:
- Voice input capture
- Natural language understanding
- Multi-turn conversation context
- Brand-aware responses
- Voice synthesis output
- Pro/standard tiers

---

#### 3. **Enhanced Extraction Service** (`enhancedExtractionService.ts` - 600+ lines)
Website analysis & brand profiling:
- HTML parsing & content extraction
- Visual analysis (colors, fonts)
- Text analysis (tone, values, messaging)
- SWOT generation
- Persona creation
- Confidence scoring
- Multi-language support
- Self-healing mode (auto-regenerate if confidence low)

---

#### 4. **Self-Healing Service** (`selfHealingService.ts`)
Quality assurance & auto-improvement:
- Asset validation (against brand guidelines)
- Issue detection & scoring
- Feedback generation
- Recursive regeneration (up to 3 attempts)
- Healing metrics & statistics
- Batch processing for multiple assets

**Validation Loop:**
1. Validate asset
2. If passes (score ≥80) → complete
3. If fails → identify issues & suggestions
4. Regenerate asset with feedback
5. Re-validate
6. Repeat (max 3 times)

---

#### 5. **RLM Service** (`rlmService.ts`)
Recursive Language Model for deep analysis:
- Multi-level analysis (root → recursive)
- Deep context windows (up to 200K tokens)
- Configurable recursion depth
- Model selection (root vs recursive)

---

#### 6. **Inference Engine Service** (`inferenceRouter.ts`)
Advanced AI techniques:
- **Speculative Decoding** — Faster generation
- **Self-Consistency** — Multiple samples for accuracy
- **Skeleton of Thought** — Structured reasoning
- **Chain of Verification** — Cross-checking outputs
- Configurable activation per feature

---

## Data Models

### BrandDNA (Core)
Complete brand profile with 30+ fields:
- Identity (name, tagline, mission)
- Strategy (values, messaging, audience)
- Visual (colors, fonts, style, extended visuals)
- Personality (tone of voice, brand archetypes)
- Competitive (SWOT, competitors)
- Personas (3-5 target audience profiles)
- Accessibility & Sonic identity
- Confidence scores

### Campaign Objects
- **CampaignPRD** — Campaign plan with user stories
- **CampaignAsset** — Individual asset (title, copy, CTA, images)
- **SavedCampaign** — Campaign + results history

### Lead Objects
- **LeadProfile** — Company info + gap analysis
- **CloserPortfolio** — Personalized sales materials
- **CloserReport** — Market analysis + recommendations

### Website Objects
- **WebsiteData** — Site structure + content
- **SiteSection** — Hero, features, about, CTA, footer

### Analysis Objects
- **BattleReport** — A/B brand comparison
- **TrendPulseItem** — Trending topics
- **HealingAttempt** — Quality validation iteration

Services & Engines

### Core AI Services

#### 1. **Gemini Service** (`geminiService.ts` - 1300+ lines)
Central hub for all AI operations:
- LLM selection & provider routing
- Prompt engineering
- Token counting & optimization
- Response parsing (JSON extraction)
- Image generation
- Campaign asset generation
- Content refinement
- RLM (Recursive Language Models) integration

**Supported LLMs:** 31 providers
- Google Gemini (primary)
- OpenAI GPT-4/4o
- Claude (Anthropic)
- Mistral, DeepSeek, Groq
- Plus 25 others (Qwen, Cohere, etc.)

---

#### 2. **Sonic Co-Pilot Service** (`sonicCoPilot.ts`)
Voice-based AI interaction:
- Voice input capture
- Natural language understanding
- Multi-turn conversation context
- Brand-aware responses
- Voice synthesis output
- Pro/standard tiers

---

#### 3. **Enhanced Extraction Service** (`enhancedExtractionService.ts` - 600+ lines)
Website analysis & brand profiling:
- HTML parsing & content extraction
- Visual analysis (colors, fonts)
- Text analysis (tone, values, messaging)
- SWOT generation
- Persona creation

- Multi-language support
- Self-healing mode (auto-regenerate if confidence low)

- Issue detection & scoring
- Feedback generation

1. Validate asset

You are an expert full-stack TypeScript/React developer fixing and massively improving the Campaign Generation feature (CampaignsPage + backend services) in a large AI marketing automation platform (CoreDNA2).

Current problems observed:
- Campaigns are not generating as complete, cohesive packages — individual assets appear isolated or random.
- Sequencing across channels/days is weak or missing.
- Autonomous mode often fails midway (stories not completed, validation loops break early).
- Self-healing doesn't consistently improve quality or learn from failures.
- PRD generation is too generic; user stories lack clear acceptance criteria tied to brand DNA + channel best practices.
- No strong feedback/learning loop captured for future campaigns.
- Multi-channel optimization feels superficial (same copy repurposed without real adaptation).

Your mission: Refactor and enhance the entire campaign workflow end-to-end so it reliably produces professional, ready-to-schedule marketing campaigns in autonomous or step-by-step mode.

New desired workflow (structured, improved version — implement this exactly):

1. Brand DNA Selection
   - User selects one saved BrandDNA object.
   - Load full BrandDNA (tone, values, colors, audience personas, visual style, sonic identity, confidence scores).
   - Validate: if confidence < 75%, prompt user to re-extract or edit before proceeding.

2. Campaign Brief Input (improved UX + intelligence)
   - Collect:
     - Campaign name & description (short)
     - Primary goal: Awareness / Engagement / Conversion / Lead Gen / Retention / Other (dropdown + custom)
     - Target audience segment (pre-fill from BrandDNA personas, allow override)
     - Budget/timeline hints (optional: e.g., "low-budget quick win", "30-day nurture")
     - Key constraints (e.g., "holiday theme", "no price mentions")
   - AI auto-suggests refinements based on BrandDNA (e.g., "Given minimalist tone, suggest subtle CTAs").

3. Channel Selection & Strategy
   - Multi-select: Instagram, LinkedIn, Twitter/X, TikTok, Email, Blog, YouTube Shorts, Facebook, Google Ads, etc.
   - For each selected channel, auto-generate a mini-channel strategy snippet:
     - Optimal post frequency
     - Format recommendations (carousel vs single image vs video)
     - Length guidelines
     - Best posting times (timezone-aware)
   - Allow user override.

4. Advanced PRD Generation (make this MUCH stronger)
   - Use geminiService (or best available LLM) with a structured system prompt to output a clean JSON PRD:
     - campaignOverview: {name, goal, audience, timeline}
     - channelStrategies: array per channel
     - userStories: array of objects, each:
       - id: string (e.g. "IG-001")
       - description: "Create 3-image carousel post announcing new product"
       - channel: string
       - assetTypes: ["social_post", "image", "video_prompt?"]
       - acceptanceCriteria: array of measurable checks (tone match ≥90%, CTA present, length 80-120 chars, etc.)
       - dependencies: array of prior story IDs (for sequencing)
       - priority: high/medium/low
     - totalAssetsTarget: number (e.g. 15–30)
     - sequencingPlan: suggested order/timeline (day 1 teaser → day 3 value → day 7 CTA)
   - Show PRD preview in UI → user can edit stories, reorder, add/remove before execution.

5. Execution Modes
   - Step-by-Step (default for control):
     - Process one user story at a time.
     - Generate full asset → run selfHealingService → if passes (>85% score) → present to user.
     - User: Approve / Edit / Regenerate / Skip.
   - Full Autonomous:
     - Run all stories in dependency order.
     - Parallelize independent stories where possible (use Promise.all with limits).
     - Every asset goes through selfHealing loop (max 5 iterations instead of 10 to save cost).
     - If >3 failures in a row on one story → pause and notify user with failure summary.

6. Asset Generation (per story)
   - For each story, produce a complete CampaignAsset object:
     - headline
     - bodyCopy (channel-optimized)
     - cta
     - imagePrompt (detailed, brand-aligned)
     - generatedImageUrl (call image provider)
     - videoPrompt + videoUrl (if video requested, use videoService)
     - emailSubject + fullBody (if email)
     - metadata: {channel, type: "post"|"email"|"ad"|"blog_section", status: "draft"|"healing"|"approved", score}
     - scheduledTimeSuggestion (based on channel best practices + user timezone)

7. Self-Healing & Quality Loop (strengthen this)
   - Validation criteria pulled from BrandDNA + acceptanceCriteria:
     - Tone match score (via brandVoiceValidatorService)
     - Visual alignment (color/typography match)
     - Engagement potential (length, hooks, CTA strength)
     - Overall coherence with campaign goal
   - If score < 85%: generate detailed feedback JSON → append to prompt → regenerate (up to 5×).
   - After each healing attempt, log insight: {storyId, issue, fixApplied, beforeScore, afterScore}

8. Learning Feedback Capture
   - After campaign completion (or per asset approval):
     - User rates assets 1–5 (thumbs up/down + optional note).
     - Auto-capture: which providers worked best, which prompts failed, common healing fixes.
     - Store in Supabase (new table: campaignLearnings) tied to BrandDNA ID.
     - Next campaign auto-injects top learnings into system prompt.

9. Review, Edit & Scheduler Integration
   - Final screen: grid/timeline view of all generated assets grouped by channel/day.
   - Inline edit for any field.
   - Bulk actions: approve all, regenerate selected.
   - One-click "Schedule Campaign" → push to SchedulerPage + create n8n/DeFi workflow triggers.
   - Option: export as JSON/CSV for external tools.

Technical requirements:
- Use existing services where possible — enhance them (especially autonomousCampaignService.ts and selfHealingService.ts).
- Keep TypeScript types strict (update types.ts if needed).
- UI: React 19 + Vite + Tailwind; add new components: CampaignBriefForm, PRDPreview, AssetTimelineGrid, HealingLogPanel.
- Error handling: graceful fallbacks if LLM/image/video fails (retry + user notification).
- Cost awareness: track tokens/credits used per campaign.

Start by:
1. Analyzing current campaignPRDService.ts, autonomousCampaignService.ts, selfHealingService.ts — suggest structural improvements.
2. Propose new/updated types for CampaignPRD, UserStory, CampaignAsset.
3. Implement the new PRD generation prompt/system prompt (make it very detailed and structured).
4. Refactor autonomous execution loop to respect dependencies and parallelize safely.
5. Add learning capture logic.

Output step-by-step plan first, then begin implementing file-by-file (create/edit only what's necessary). Use Ralph-style loop if running in that mode — commit progress frequently.

Go!

**Analyzing Campaign Overhaul**

Okay, so I'm diving deep into the planned overhaul of the Campaign Generation feature within `CoreDNA2`. Right now, I'm focusing on the `CampaignsPage` frontend and the backend services like `campaignPRDService`, `autonomousCampaignService`, and `self`. I need to figure out the scope of changes, assess dependencies, and brainstorm potential architectural shifts to optimize things for maximum effectiveness.


**Revising Data Structures**

I've been working on refining the data models. I'm focusing on enhancing `UserStory`, `CampaignPRD`, and `CampaignAsset`, and adding a new `CampaignLearning` type. I'm also planning to rewrite the `createCampaignPRD` function to use a structured prompt that considers BrandDNA, Brief, and Channel Strategy. This revised function will output the enhanced `CampaignPRD` structure.


**Improving Self-Healing & Frontend**

I'm focused on improving `selfHealingService.ts`. I am adding a new validation check `validateAssetQuality` against `BrandDNA` and `UserStory.acceptanceCriteria`. I will also update `healAsset` to utilize the new validation and retry up to five times. Additionally, I plan on logging insights from the new system. On the frontend, I am starting with a new `CampaignBriefForm` component that collects goal, audience, and constraints and displays AI suggestions.


**Integrating Campaign Learning**

I'm now integrating campaign learning into the architecture. I'm focusing on adding a `CampaignLearning` type and implementing the storage and retrieval of campaign learnings to enable their injection into future PRD generation. Currently, I'm mocking the storage aspect, but I'll consider using Supabase if it fits the "frontend-first" approach. I need to make sure I update `types.ts` to include the structures I need.


**Structuring Asset Data**

I'm now focusing on refining the structures for `CampaignAsset`. I am designing an interface that will include headline, body copy, and CTA elements. I'm also planning the incorporation of relevant hashtags. I'm aiming for flexibility and completeness within the defined structure.


**Refining Campaign Asset**

I'm deep into designing the data structure for `CampaignAsset`, specifically considering the inclusion of fields for tags, visuals like image and video prompts and URLs, and email-specific details. Metadata for channel, type, status, and scoring are also crucial. I am also working on `HealingReport` interface, and `CampaignLearning` interface. I'm aiming for comprehensive asset representation within this structure.


**Orchestrating Service Logic**

I'm now focusing on orchestrating the service logic. I've defined a structured execution loop for the autonomous service, which prioritizes dependent stories and manages concurrency to prevent rate limiting. I'm also planning a step-by-step wizard UI in the CampaignsPage. The plan to generate code is coming together, the key steps are `types.ts`, `geminiService`, `campaignPRDService`, `selfHealingService`, `autonomousCampaignService`, and `CampaignsPage`.

Here is the comprehensive plan to overhaul the Campaign Generation engine in CoreDNA2.

### **Paradigm Shift: The Autonomous Campaign Orchestra**

We are moving from "random asset generation" to a **structured, strategic campaign orchestration engine**.
1.  **Strategic Blueprinting (PRD 2.0)**: The AI first acts as a Strategist, defining a multi-channel plan with dependencies (e.g., "Teaser first, then Launch, then Reminder").
2.  **Graph-Based Execution**: The engine executes stories based on dependencies, not just a linear list.
3.  **Strict Self-Healing**: Assets are not just "generated"; they are "manufactured" through a rigorous quality control loop (Generate -> Critique -> Fix -> Verify).
4.  **Feedback Memory**: The system learns from what you approve/reject (mocked for now via local state/console).

### **Implementation Plan**

1.  **`types.ts`**: Redefine `CampaignPRD`, `UserStory`, and `CampaignAsset` to support dependencies, sequencing, and detailed metadata.
2.  **`services/geminiService.ts`**: Upgrade the prompt engineering for `generatePRD` to output the complex strategy JSON and `generateAssetFromStory` to handle multi-modal outputs (video/email/social).
3.  **`services/selfHealingService.ts`**: Implement the "Strict Validator" which checks tone, visual alignment, and specific acceptance criteria, with a max-5 retry loop.
4.  **`services/autonomousCampaignService.ts`**: Rewrite the engine to use a dependency-graph approach (executing available stories in parallel) and integrate the new healing loop.
5.  **`pages/CampaignsPage.tsx`**: Completely redesign the UI into a 4-step wizard: **Briefing -> Strategy Review -> Execution -> Asset Dashboard**.

---

### **Code Changes**

```javascript
import { BrandDNA, WebsiteData, SiteSection } from "../types";
import { GoogleGenAI } from "@google/genai";

const API_KEY = process.env.API_KEY || ''; 

let ai: GoogleGenAI | null = null;

const getAI = () => {
  if (!ai && API_KEY) {
    ai = new GoogleGenAI({ apiKey: API_KEY });
  }
  return ai;
};

export const generateWebsiteStructure = async (brand: BrandDNA): Promise<WebsiteData> => {
  const client = getAI();
  if (!client) throw new Error("API Key missing");

  const prompt = `
    Act as a UX/UI Web Designer. Create content for a landing page for the brand "${brand.name}".
    
    Brand Context:
    Tagline: ${brand.tagline}
    Mission: ${brand.mission}
    Values: ${brand.coreValues.join(', ')}
    Visual Style: ${brand.visualIdentity.styleKeywords.join(', ')}
    
    Generate content for these sections:
    1. Hero (Headline, Subheadline, CTA Label)
    2. Features (3 Key features with titles and descriptions)
    3. About (Short paragraph about the mission)
    4. CTA (Final call to action)

    Return JSON structure:
  `;

  try {
    const model = client.getGenerativeModel({ model: "gemini-3-flash-preview" });
    const result = await model.generateContent(prompt);
    const response = await result.response;
    const jsonString = response.text();
    const data: WebsiteData = JSON.parse(jsonString);

    return {
      hero: {
        headline: data.hero.headline,
        subheadline: data.hero.subheadline,
        ctaLabel: data.hero.ctaLabel,
      },
      features: data.features.map(f => ({
        title: f.title,
        description: f.description
      })),
      about: {
        paragraph: data.about.paragraph,
      },
      cta: {
        label: data.cta.label,
      }
    };
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("Error generating website structure:", error);
    throw new Error(`Failed to generate website structure: ${error.message}`);
  }
};
```

**Addressing Storage Limits**

I've hit a snag. The `localStorage` quota's been exceeded because the `zustand` store, via its `persist` middleware, is trying to store the entire state, including those hefty base64 images. Now, I need to figure out a workaround to avoid this problem.


**Prioritizing IndexedDB Implementation**

I'm leaning towards IndexedDB (Option A) as the primary solution. It's the most robust for managing those hefty images and large data structures in `campaigns` and `videoJobs`, effectively preventing the `localStorage` quota issue in the long run. Setting up that custom storage seems like the right move, even with some added complexity. I'm focusing on implementation to make this solution the primary focus of my thought process.


**Refining Storage Approach**

I'm now prioritizing a specific response to the immediate storage error. Initially, the custom IndexedDB solution seemed like the definitive answer for long-term data management. However, I've re-evaluated that approach. The immediate goal is to address the hard error the user is experiencing. Now, I'm focusing on two options. First, I'll attempt a `partialize` filter in the `persist` middleware to exclude the biggest data chunks, like base64 images. Second, I'll consider an alternative solution to the problem.


**Implementing IndexedDB Solution**
